intro.text: A Rosharan nation badly affected by the Everstorm and the collapse of regional trade.

description.text: The mountains south of Tu Bayla hold Urithiru.
Tu Baylans keep a breed of tame minks as pets and to help them hunt.
Tu Bayla has a rich musical tradition and an unusually wide variety of instruments.

items.text: Tu Baylans are described as a nomadic people.
Tu Baylans live in tribes, and it is unclear whether they have a true government. Partly for that, other peoples tend to look down on them as uncivilized.
Most other nations see Tu Bayla as a backwater.
Tu Bayla has a rich musical tradition and an unusually wide variety of instruments.
Many Tu Baylans love to sing, and Taravangian thought their music beautiful.
Tu Baylans do not split food into masculine and feminine kinds as Vorins do; anyone may eat anything.
Tu Baylans keep a breed of tame minks as pets and to help them hunt.
Girls are usually named after stars, and boys after flowers.
Neighboring powers repeatedly fought over Tu Bayla, including Azir, Jah Keved and Alethkar.
The Everstorm destroyed crops, and trade between Azir and Jah Keved broke down. Famine undermined the government, allowing warlords to control communities through their food supplies.
During the Night of Sorrows, the Purelake overflowed into parts of Tu Bayla while the unending Everstorm kept the country in darkness.

told.title: Carved from two kingdoms
told.text: Tu Bayla took shape from parts of Sela Tales and Valhav after those Silver Kingdoms collapsed, though it is unclear when it became a nation, or when others began to count it as one.

told.title: A battleground for others
told.text: For millennia outsiders thought little of Tu Bayla and fought their wars on its soil, mostly Azir against Jah Keved, or against Alethkar when Alethkar held the Veden lands. It happened again and again.

told.title: Famine and warlords
told.text: Once the Everstorm came, it ruined Tu Bayla's crops, and trade between Azir and Jah Keved ended. Famine and chaos killed many, children among them. The government fell, and warlords seized supplies and used them to rule.

told.title: The coalition eyes an invasion
told.text: Not long after the battle at Thaylen City, the coalition of monarchs considered invading Tu Bayla to head off attacks on Jah Keved that could split the coalition's lands in two.

told.title: The Purelake floods
told.text: After Retribution folded the highstorm into the Everstorm, the Purelake flooded parts of Tu Bayla.
